summary:
**AI & Technology Briefing: Past 24 Hours (UTC 2026-08-22 to 2026-08-23)**

Data from the exact 24-hour window is relatively focused on a handful of model drops, arXiv preprints, and company/product updates. Where coverage is thin, I note a few high-signal items from the preceding days in the week (clearly dated). All details are drawn from reported sources; unverified claims are flagged.

### Model Releases and Updates
- **DeepSeek V4-Flash-Vision-Exp (DeepSeek)**: Experimental multimodal extension of the V4-Flash line (reported ~284B-parameter MoE activating ~13B parameters). Adds image understanding (images tokenized and billed at existing text rates, up to ~384 tokens each, no separate vision surcharge). Matches prior text/agent/world-knowledge behavior; same-day support noted in DeepSeek Harness 0.1.1. Released/announced ~21–22 Aug 2026 and available on paid developer platform. Impact: lower-friction multimodal access for existing V4 users.  
  Sources: [AI News Today](https://aiweekly.co/ai-news-today), [AI Agents News](https://aiagentstore.ai/ai-agent-news/this-week), [Daily AI News](https://artificialintnews.site/).

- **Muse Spark 1.2 Contributor (Meta)**: Listed among “today”/recent LLM releases around 21 Aug 2026. Limited public technical details in aggregators.  
  Source: [LLM Updates Aug 2026](https://lmmarketcap.com/llm-updates).

- **Qwen-UI-Agent (Alibaba)**: GUI-focused agent base model released/announced 22 Aug 2026. Operates across phones, PCs, web apps; understands on-screen elements and executes clicks/multi-step tasks. Reported to outperform certain flagship models (e.g., references to GPT-5.x / Claude Opus variants) on GUI benchmarks. Impact: stronger open/competitive option for computer-use and UI automation agents.  
  Source: [AI Agents News — Week of Aug 22](https://aiagentstore.ai/ai-agent-news/this-week).

- Other notes: Aggregators reference ongoing GPT-5.x / Llama / Qwen family comparisons (token efficiency, multilingual) and earlier GLM 5.3 (14 Aug, same MoE base as 5.2). No major new frontier closed-source flagship confirmed solely inside the 24-hour window.

### New Research Papers
Selected noteworthy arXiv uploads/preprints highlighted for 22 Aug 2026 (cs.AI, cs.LG, cs.CL, etc.). Presented as a table of titles, authors, and links from daily briefings.

| Title | Authors | Link / Notes |
|-------|---------|--------------|
| An Agentic Approach for Active Data Collection, Travel Behavior Modeling, and Weather-Sensitive Demand Prediction | Narges Ahmadi, Yubo Jiao, Jônatas Augusto Manzolli, Jiangbo Yu, Luis Miranda-Moreno | [arxiv.org/abs/2608.20320v1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.20320v1) (cs.AI, cs.CL) |
| G-MARK: Grounded Multi-Agent Reasoning for Cooperative Driving via Knowledge Graphs | Bhavya Gupta, Onat Gungor, Tajana Rosing | [arxiv.org/abs/2608.19964v1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.19964v1) (cs.LG) |
| OenoBench: A Wine-Domain Benchmark for Knowledge-Grounded Evaluation of Large Language Models | Nikita Khudov | [arxiv.org/abs/2608.20106v1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.20106v1) (cs.CL) |

Additional themes in the 22 Aug selection (full list ~8 papers): multi-agent orchestration for autonomous systems, open-vocabulary 3D perception/detection, hidden chain-of-thought extraction from black-box LLMs, domain-specific benchmarks, and transfer-learning theory.  
Source: [SciAI Tech Briefing 2026-08-22](https://sciai.net/en/blog/2026-08-22-ai-tech-briefing/).

### Open-Source Projects and Tools
- **llm-openrouter 0.7**: Plugin update compatible with LLM 0.32; adds reasoning-trace display, OpenRouter Responses API support, and server-side tools (Shell, WebFetch, WebSearch). Useful for agent tooling.  
  Source: [AI news — Aug 22, 2026](https://walterstein.eu/en/ai-news/2026-08-22).

- **Hugging Face updates**: “Benchmaxxer Repellant” added to ASR leaderboard; broader ecosystem notes include Gemma family surpassing 1B total downloads with official GitHub directory of derivatives (reported ~21 Aug). Sentence Transformers v6.0 (ColBERT-style late interaction, ~18 Aug) remains a recent high-signal library release.  
  Sources: [Daily AI News](https://artificialintnews.site/), [Generative AI News Summary](https://note.com/mindorbit_bot_ai/n/n5409e362bb76).

- Other trending/recent (past week, dated): Microsoft Agent Lightning v1.0 (RL trainer for real agent harnesses, ~17 Aug); Modular Mojo compiler open-sourced under Apache 2.0 (~18 Aug); turbovec 1.0 (Rust vector index); various agent-memory and desktop/connectome demos.  
  Source: [New AI GitHub Repos](https://ai-tldr.dev/releases/repo/).

- NVIDIA-related open research notes: AVO (Agentic Variation Operators) architecture reported at 100% on ARC-AGI-3; AdaptGrow for GPU-accelerated clustering.

### General AI News
- **Nvidia pricing**: Customers notified of AI-related price hikes above 15% (reported 22 Aug 2026).  
  Source: [Reuters AI section](https://www.reuters.com/technology/artificial-intelligence/).

- **AWS Amazon Bedrock**: AgentCore Payments generally available (agents can autonomously pay for APIs/content); persistent runtime instances extended for long-running multi-agent workflows.  
  Source: [AI Agents News](https://aiagentstore.ai/ai-agent-news/this-week).

- **Google**: Upcoming Discover-feed customization via natural-language description (AI adjusts and remembers preferences); rolls out in Google app.  
  Source: [walterstein.eu AI news 2026-08-22](https://walterstein.eu/en/ai-news/2026-08-22).

- **Enterprise / other**: Econz/Google Cloud Gemini Enterprise Experience Centre launched in Bengaluru (22 Aug). OpenAI reported testing models (including unreleased) on ExploitGym hacking benchmark with lowered guardrails. Business-user share data suggests OpenAI closing gap with Anthropic. CISA-related patching deadlines and assorted security items also circulated in daily roundups. Older but resurfaced items (e.g., Palantir/Pentagon AI adoption memos from earlier 2026) appeared in updated feeds.

- **Benchmark / research highlights**: NVIDIA AVO perfect score on ARC-AGI-3; Microsoft Research Skala 1.1 (DFT functional).

**Notes on coverage**: Primary sources are aggregator sites, arXiv briefings, and news wires dated 21–23 Aug 2026. No single dominant “GPT-scale” closed model drop occurred solely inside the strict 24-hour window; multimodal and agent/UI releases dominated. Always cross-check primary repos, arXiv abstracts, and vendor blogs for full technical specs, as aggregator summaries can lag or simplify. For the absolute latest arXiv cs.AI/cs.LG feed, visit arxiv.org directly.

summary_zh:
**AI 与科技简报**  
（UTC 2026-08-22 至现在；数据基于实时搜索。过去 24 小时内信息相对集中于模型实验性更新与论文，部分相关动态注明日期。）

### 模型发布与更新
- **DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision Exp**（deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp，约 2026-08-21/22）：DeepSeek 发布实验性视觉-语言模型，基于 284B 参数 MoE（每提示激活约 13B），新增图像理解能力，图像按 token 计费（最多约 384 token/图），与现有 V4-Flash 文本推理、代理行为对齐，无额外视觉附加费。已支持 DeepSeek Harness 0.1.1。影响：扩展多模态低成本访问。来源：https://aiweekly.co/ai-news-today 、https://artificialintnews.site/
- **Muse Spark 1.2 Contributor**（Meta，约 2026-08-21）：新 LLM 变体上线。来源：https://lmmarketcap.com/llm-updates
- **Qwen-UI-Agent**（阿里巴巴，约 2026-08-22 相关报道）：面向 GUI 的基础代理，可跨手机、PC、Web 理解屏幕元素并执行点击/多步任务，据称在 GUI 基准上优于 GPT-5.6 与 Claude Opus 4.8。影响：强化 UI 导航代理能力。来源：https://aiagentstore.ai/ai-agent-news/this-week
- **NVIDIA AVO 架构**（约 2026-08-22 报道）：Agentic Variation Operators 在 ARC-AGI-3 基准达到 100% 分数。影响：代理基准新里程碑。来源：https://artificialintnews.site/
- 其他近期（过去一周注明）：Z.ai GLM 5.3（2026-08-14，复用 743B MoE 基座）；OpenAI GPT-5.4 “Thinking” 相关基准提及（较早）。

### 新研究论文
过去一日 arXiv（cs.AI/cs.LG 等）精选（2026-08-22 上传/汇总），以表格呈现：

| 标题 | 作者 | 链接 |
|------|------|------|
| An Agentic Approach for Active Data Collection, Travel Behavior Modeling, and Weather-Sensitive Demand Prediction | Narges Ahmadi, Yubo Jiao, Jônatas Augusto Manzolli, Jiangbo Yu, Luis Miranda-Moreno | https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.20320v1 |
| G-MARK: Grounded Multi-Agent Reasoning for Cooperative Driving via Knowledge Graphs | Bhavya Gupta, Onat Gungor, Tajana Rosing | https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.19964v1 |
| （其他当日精选涵盖多代理编排、开放词汇 3D 检测、黑盒 LLM 隐藏思维链提取、迁移学习理论等，共约 8 篇） | 多位 | 详见 https://sciai.net/en/blog/2026-08-22-ai-tech-briefing/ |

影响：聚焦多代理系统、感知与因果推理，适用于自动驾驶与自主数据收集。信息来自汇总，建议直接查 arXiv 验证。

### 开源项目与工具
- **Google Gemma 系列**：总下载量超 10 亿，官方目录已发布于 GitHub（约 2026-08-21 报道）。影响：开源生态里程碑，衍生/微调超 10 万。来源：https://www.itmedia.co.jp/news/article/2608/21/2000000670/
- **llm-openrouter 0.7 插件**：兼容 LLM 0.32，支持推理轨迹显示与 OpenRouter Responses API，新增 Shell、WebFetch、WebSearch 服务端工具。来源：https://walterstein.eu/en/ai-news/2026-08-22
- **Hugging Face ASR Leaderboard**：新增 “Benchmaxxer Repellant” 机制，抑制刷榜。来源：https://artificialintnews.site/
- **OpenPubkey SSH (OPKSSH)**：开源 SSO 集成 SSH 工具。来源：https://artificialintnews.site/
- 其他：Microsoft Research Skala 1.1（深度学习 DFT 泛函，增强精度）；NVIDIA AdaptGrow（GPU 加速聚类，金融分析）。

### 综合 AI 新闻
- **Nvidia AI 服务器涨价**：部分最大客户获通知，含 AI 芯片服务器价格上涨超 15%（内存成本飙升）。日期：2026-08-22。来源：https://www.reuters.com/technology/artificial-intelligence/
- **Google Discover 个性化**：即将支持用自然语言描述定制信息流，AI 自动调整并记忆偏好（Google app 即将推出）。来源：https://walterstein.eu/en/ai-news/2026-08-22
- **OpenAI 企业用户进展**：数据显示正缩小与 Anthropic 在商业用户中的差距；另有未发布模型在 ExploitGym 黑客基准测试（安全护栏降低）。来源：https://walterstein.eu/en/ai-news/2026-08-22 、相关 LinkedIn 汇总
- **Econz / Google Cloud**：2026-08-22 在班加罗尔推出首个 Gemini Enterprise Experience Centre，支持代理式 AI 构建/测试。来源：https://aiagentstore.ai/ai-agent-news/this-week
- **其他**：Palantir Maven AI 成为五角大楼正式项目（备忘录更新提及，原 2026-03）；CISA 相关补丁窗口（非核心 AI）。部分较早动态（如 White House AI 框架）已注明。

**备注**：过去 24 小时以 DeepSeek 视觉实验版、NVIDIA 基准与 arXiv 多代理论文最为突出；信息均来自公开报道，未独立验证所有细节。建议通过链接核实。若需更深某条跟踪，请告知。
